item.title: And for my 25th tale...
item.content:encoded:
This has been something I have been wanting to write for awhile, but only have now gotten around to putting into words. With a lot of my more recent tales being rather action heavy, fast paced, and wizard-battle filled, I felt this was a nice change of pace. Additionally, it gave me a chance to expand on the character of Director Holman, who is currently my longest running recurring character on the site. This tale probably won't blow your mind, or be the best thing since sliced bread, but I am pleased with it.

Special thanks to Taffeta, TyGently, TwistedGears, GreenWolf, Fausto, Roget, minmin, Lex1nat0r, A Random Day, and AbsentmindedNihilist for all their feedback in the drafting stage.

Happy Halloween.
